purpose: Wave 2 annotation-only publisher scope; separate from the historical M7 candidate snapshot.

sources.licence_constraint: BLS identifies its published material as public domain except previously copyrighted photographs/illustrations. Attribute BLS. Do not download images, reuse the BLS emblem, or imply endorsement.
sources.timing_rule: Use America/New_York only when the retained page explicitly declares Eastern Time; otherwise quarantine date-only timing.
sources.availability_rule: Capture completion is locally observed availability. Preserve first observation and append local semantic revisions. Do not infer historical first publication.
sources.retention: Original HTML response bytes and attributed schedule metadata only; no linked assets or article bodies.
sources.access_failure_policy: Retain explicit retrieval failure; respect access denial and retry limits. Never treat an error page as a healthy empty calendar.
adoption_requirements: Verify actual raw response parsing through the permitted collection path
Bind deployed parser, source declaration and capture storage versions
Configure acquisition cadence, timeout, retention location and failure reporting
Keep annotations optional and separate from order eligibility
